sloka: ते तु सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः।कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे रणायाभिमुखा ययुः ।। ६.९६.७ ।।
transliteration: te tu sarve tathetyuktvā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ।kṛtasvastyayanāḥ sarve raṇāyābhimukhā yayuḥ ।। 6.96.7 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas with frightful looks saying 'Be it so', having prepared themselves with armor went towards the battlefield.
